sources.title: Other national reimbursement schemes (Belgium mHealthBelgium, etc.)
sources.why: Requires separate per-market clinical studies, forcing validation across different national populations rather than reusing evidence cross-border.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: Its quality dimensions cover usability and fitness for the target population, the framework against which multilingual and cultural validation is assessed.
